{{recipe}} | [[Cookbook:Cuisine of Spain|Spanish cuisine]]

'''Polvorones''' are a type of Spanish shortbread quite popular in Latin America.

==Ingredients==

*1 [[Cookbook:Cup|cup]] [[Cookbook:Margarine|margarine]]
*1 cup white [[Cookbook:Sugar|sugar]]
*½ [[Cookbook:Teaspoon|tsp]] [[Cookbook:Salt|salt]]
*4 cups [[Cookbook:Flour|all-purpose flour]]
*2 [[Cookbook:Egg|eggs]]
*1 tsp [[Cookbook:Vanilla|vanilla]] extract

==Procedure==
#Preheat [[Cookbook:Oven|oven]] to 350°F (180°C)
#Mix the margarine and the sugar in a mixing bowl until it reaches a creamy consistency.
#Mix in the vanilla extract, salt, and eggs.
#While mixing the ingredients, add the flour and stir until it becomes hard to stir the mix.
#Make small balls and place on a flat [[Cookbook:Baking Sheet|baking sheet]] without grease.
#[[Cookbook:Baking|Bake]] for 15–20 minutes in the preheated oven, or until golden.
#Let cool.
